method: Expected verdicts and control IDs withheld; frozen evidence and authored candidates supplied.
limitations: Small authored set selected by the parent; no representative production outputs.
Expected labels withheld from judge, but supplied source notes explain provenance and event scope.
A prior unblinded agent reviewed and repaired the positive controls.
One judge, one attempt, no repeated-run variability or held-out calibration dataset.
Host agent identity, usage cost and complete session elapsed time were not independently measured.
No live source, production refresh, provider reasoning comparison or video understanding trial.
Agreement does not establish release readiness or broad judge calibration.
Evidence text was normalized from Windows CRLF to repository LF; original workspace byte digests are retained and reconstructable by restoring CRLF. Source JSON values and judgments are unchanged.
